unweighted_result: No attribution to new hard examples: blue scene counts match the corresponding control in both seeds on all three development panels. Seed48 removes one blue false positive on the 67-frame panel in BOTH arms. Admit47 additionally loses one red true positive on the 12-frame panel. Reject promotion.
weighted_result: Both weighted admit seeds correctly classify two of the five reviewed hard training crops, versus one for the matched controls. Preserved ordinary training accuracy is 1449/1487 and 1451/1487. Neither meets the predeclared four-of-five learnability requirement, so neither was evaluated on development scenes.
next_direction: Check longer training-only convergence and per-crop probability trajectories with the same guarded labels and matched control. Loss was still decreasing after eight epochs; this diagnostic does not prove a capacity ceiling. Require fit and retention before further development evaluation. New full frames may also support localization review, but current crop approval does not certify complete scene truth.
